_comment: Porter MCP server for Google Antigravity. HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcpServers.porter block into ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json. NOTE the vendor-specific key: "serverUrl" (HTTP transport) instead of command/args. UNVERIFIED (prominent): no source confirms how Antigravity attaches an Authorization header; if it cannot send a custom Authorization header carrying {{PORTER_TOKEN}}, Porter's bearer-token requirement will NOT work over this HTTP transport — verify on a real install before relying on it. Not tested against a live Antigravity install here.
